judged_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/createOAuthAppCredential.ts:56 — An accepted non-admin team member can install team-wide OAuth credentials by supplying teamId in state because `return;` exits the team branch after `await prisma.credential.create({` and before `await throwIfNotHaveAdminAccessToTeam({ teamId: state?.teamId ?? null, userId });`, bypassing the administrator authorization check for every team installation.
